g.text: SD04 - Live Correction / Combined / Timed Command (UC04, UC05; F06-F09)
Precondition: held {RIGHT}; an older request v41 may still be in flight.
New input v42 supersedes v41 immediately. Existing motion continues until
a valid replacement is accepted, its timer expires, or cleanup releases it.
GUI partial transcripts use this same flow (SD01).
[current valid decision repeats the same accepted semantic result in this utterance]
[current metadata, active player, and valid schema]
No opposed pair; at most two perpendicular directions.
Duration is bounded to 100/200/400 ms; "a little" = 200 ms.
KeyDown is idempotent. Reasserting both desired directions
restores RIGHT if cancelAll released an older timed RIGHT.
Diagonal movement is normalized to the same total speed.
Record accepted decision and increment revision.
[obsolete metadata or movement no longer allowed]
[still latest version/epoch and active; only context revision changed]
SD01 failure handling invokes SD05 cleanup; notify the selected view.
[fixed ticks while newTimed is active; stop after expiry or cancellation]
Remove the completed timer from activeTimed.
Planning, cancellation, and replacement execute atomically on the application loop.
No timer callback runs independently. KEEP_CURRENT, NO_ACTION, and an identical
semantic result in the same utterance preserve the current timer rather than restart it.
A completion dispatched before a timer expiry fails the changed-revision check.
